head: f9fdb2149e240b0e95ef2253c8546a0d7da7ae2d
aggregation: Median of all six independent mount rates; no sample exclusions. Latency percentiles use nearest rank; latency median is conventional median.
decision: Keep the candidate isolated; do not change the production SDK/default. Common sync costs improve but strict small-file total-time throughput and long tails fail a general acceptance gate.
next_integration: Linux opt-in SQLite build support with actual syscall/error tests; a default change requires strict and aged latency/total-time acceptance on the intended storage.
